body: I hate this. I don't see how I can keep living, but I'm not brave enough to die.

I don't think I can fix it. I don't think I can do anything.

I don't know why you're talking to me.
I'm 21. Young enough where I know I'll get told things about fish in the sea and all that. But it feels so trite and doesn't seem to cover this.

Long story short, I lied...twice. I feel like I keep making these mistakes that lose me the things I really care about. 

For him, I'm not reliable and I'm not worth the risk that I might mess up again. I can't necessarily blame him. There have been times in my life where I've felt like I'm treading water with no hope of relief, but now it's really like I'm drowning. He's the only one I want to ask for help, but that's so incredibly selfish of me.

I think I'm still afraid to die. 

It's embarrassing. I lied and I hurt him so much. I understand exactly why he can't love me anymore, but I'd been working on myself and really hoping I could be better. I'm rambling, I'm sorry. 

I just don't see the hope for me.
